question: AIIMS has signed an MoU with which institution to set up a Centre of Excellence for AI in Healthcare?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**IIT Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• AIIMS Delhi, IIT Delhi to establish Center of Excellence for AI in healthcare.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**AIIMS** and **IIT Delhi** signed an **MoU** to set up a **Centre of Excellence for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare (AI-CoE)**.

 
 
• 
 
The **AI-CoE** will focus on **AI-driven healthcare solutions**.

 
 
• 
 
Aim: To support and **strengthen national health programmes** in India.

 
 
• 
 
This initiative marks a **transformative era** in **medical research**.
